Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: In the very first step, the WebSurfer failed to correctly interpret the search results. While the results clearly stated that "Goosebumpz" is a song by Mac Miller (citing Wikipedia), the agent's initial output focused on a different entity named "Goosebumpz" described as an "electronic downtempo performer" from Melbourne, Australia. This misinterpretation led to a confusion between a song title and an artist name, although the Planner subsequently corrected this path. The error was a failure to prioritize the definitive source (Wikipedia) which identified the song and artist correctly over the ambiguous search snippet.
